chunks: As for what has been narrated through the Shia (special ones), it is more than can be counted; however, we mention a portion of it:

key_terms.الْخَاصَّةِ: The Shia (special ones), referring to the followers of the Ahl al-Bayt

ai.seo_question: How many reports exist regarding the twelve Imams in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi opens this section by acknowledging the vastness of the *ahadith* concerning the twelve Imams, distinguishing these specific narrations from the general public reports (*al-'amma*). By stating they are 'too numerous to count,' he emphasizes the weight of *tawatur* (consecutive transmission) in Shia tradition, justifying his selective presentation as a representative sample rather than an exhaustive list.
